summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.80/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.80 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 12, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 4¢ lower than a week ago, 20¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.02 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.59) and the highest in Superior ($4.03).
